content:
Sara: Morning — kicking off a short CS ceremony for client Arelia tomorrow. Goal: align stakeholders, lock success criteria, surface renewal risks, and agree on a 15-day ramp plan. Agenda below. @Priya @Mike could you confirm attendees? :wave:

Priya: I can lead enablement + docs handoff. Planning two sessions: dev-focused and product-focused. Will collect feedback after each.

Mike: I'll own infra checklist (API keys, VPC egress, quantization profile). Need customer infra contact and test cluster access.

Dan: I'll track adoption milestones and renewal watchlist. Suggest baseline target: 50k tokens/day by day 15 to consider "healthy".

Sara: Proposed cadence (quick):
```
Day 0: tech intro + SSO handshake
Day 1-3: integration & smoke tests
Day 4-7: perf tuning + batching config
Day 8-12: enablement + training
Day 13-15: feedback sprint + go/no-go decision
```
Can folks add blockers/unknowns by EOD? :calendar:

Priya: For enablement, I'll publish slides tonight. Draft deck: https://go.redwood/demo-deck

Mike: Risk callout — if SSO is delayed > 7 days we lose user analytics and training fidelity. Tagging RISK-SSO. Also customer requested private deployment options which may extend timeline.

Dan: Renewal note — renewal window in ~11 months, so early adoption signals matter. I'll add adoption KPIs to the success dashboard.

Sara: I set up a 15-min daily sync starting tomorrow 09:15 PST — invite sent to core team and customer SRE. @onboard-bot, please create a shared checklist and owner tags.

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.checklists/1793141592 — includes meeting cadence, owners, docs link, and risk tags.

Priya: Quick QA on success metric: recommend "integration green + 3 demo flows passing + median latency <250ms on 1k-token sample". Thoughts?

Mike: Agreed. Also requesting customer test cluster access by EOD tomorrow so we can run quantization and throughput tests.

Sara: Owners confirmed: Priya = enablement & feedback, Mike = infra & perf, Dan = adoption & renewal watch, Sara = exec sync & escalation.

Priya: I'll collect feedback with a short form after each enablement session: https://forms.redwood/enablement-feedback

Dan: +1. We'll run a retrospective on day 14 and capture actions for go/no-go.

Sara: Thanks — I'll update the project board and ping any outstanding blockers. If anyone sees a critical risk, call it out here and we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
